title: mizorewww/laya-mlx
why_read: A native Apple Silicon (MLX) runtime claiming sub-15ms inference for small typed decision models is a useful practical engineering detail for anyone deploying such models locally on Macs.
analysis: This project provides a native MLX runtime, Apple's machine learning framework for Apple Silicon, specifically optimized for the 'Laya' typed decision models mentioned elsewhere in this batch. The claimed 7-14ms latency on an M3 Max chip for short decisions, without needing PyTorch or a cloud API, is a meaningful practical engineering result for anyone wanting fast, local, on-device inference. This kind of hardware-specific optimization work is valuable for the growing on-device AI ecosystem, though it's a narrow, tool-specific contribution rather than a broad innovation. As with related items, the reported popularity numbers seem unusually high for such a specialized runtime.
